structured.approach: I read all FE-04 inputs, the frontend-steps skill and the ap_portal repo (index.js, tests, ci.mjs, package.json, README, CLAUDE.md). I built FC-1 to FC-8 from task.components in src/ap_portal/index.js, following feat.design B4.2/B4.4 and feat.screens FS-1/FS-2. That covers the constants, the escape helper, the string-only amount helper, the risk-class allow-list, a private row builder and the exported renderOverdueRisk. I also moved VERSION to 2.4.0. I documented the change in README.md and a new docs/ap_portal.md, then ran `node ci.mjs`. tests/ and package.json are outside this step's write scope and the tool policy blocked scratch tests, so a read-only verifier subagent checked the code and docs by reading them. I corrected the points it raised. I wrote task.code.md with the files changed, how the code meets each AC, the CI result and the open questions.
tools_used: Bash (node ci.mjs, git status, git diff --stat)

claims.text: renderOverdueRisk is added to src/ap_portal/index.js and exported next to VERSION, LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary, which are unchanged.

renderOverdueRisk returns '' for undefined, null or [] and throws TypeError for any other non-array. Otherwise it returns <table class="overdue-risk">, a plain header row Invoice, Vendor, Days overdue, Amount, and one <tr class="risk-…"> per row in the given order.
The amount is handled only as a string matching ^-?\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$ and padded to two decimals as text. Number(), parseFloat and formatAmount are never used, in line with D-2026-044 and L-011.
id and vendor are HTML-escaped (&, <, >, ", '). The row class is restricted to the four risk values, and anything else renders risk-unknown.
VERSION moved from 2.3.0 to 2.4.0 (one minor step). package.json still says 2.3.0 because it is outside this step's write scope.
node ci.mjs: compile true, 2 tests run with 0 failures, no static issues, line coverage 56.45 against the 90 bar, so passed is false on coverage only.
Unit tests for the new code belong to FE-05. tests/ is not in this step's write scope (src/ap_portal/, docs/, README.md).
README.md and the new docs/ap_portal.md describe renderOverdueRisk's inputs, outputs, TypeError cases and an example.

open_questions: CQ-1: CI fails on coverage (56.45 against 90) until FE-05 adds the feat.design B4.5 tests, because tests/ is outside FE-04's write scope and the step's tool policy blocked scratch tests. Is a coverage-only failure acceptable for FE-04's automated check?
CQ-2: package.json "version" is still 2.3.0 while VERSION is 2.4.0. package.json is outside FE-04's write scope, so a later step (FE-05 or FE-06) needs to set it to 2.4.0.
CQ-3: Confirm 2.4.0 as the minor version step (carried from task.components CQ-FE-2).
Carried and unchanged: TQ-6, TQ-7, TQ-11, OQ-B8, OQ-B9, OQ-B10, DQ-3, PQ-P7, CQ-FE-1 (styles for risk-* classes).
structured.summary: STORY-07 is coded in ap_portal: renderOverdueRisk and its private helpers in src/ap_portal/index.js, VERSION 2.4.0, README.md and the new docs/ap_portal.md. Nothing is committed. CI compiles, the 2 existing tests pass and there are no static issues, but CI fails on line coverage (56.45 against 90) because the new code has no tests yet. tests/ is outside this step's scope and the tool policy blocked scratch tests, so FE-05 must add them. package.json's version also still needs to move to 2.4.0 in a later step.
